en-US.title: VagaGo
en-US.subtitle: Stays in Vagamon, Kerala
en-US.description:
Book cottages, homestays and villas in Vagamon, Kerala, and pay when you arrive.

VagaGo makes a hill-station getaway simple:

• Real prices for your dates, with the best deals in Vagamon up front
• Book in a minute with just your name and mobile number
• Nothing to pay now: you pay the property at check-in
• The exact address, directions and the host's number appear the moment you book
• See how far every stay is from Vagamon Meadows, the Pine Forest, Marmala Waterfalls and more
• Cancel from the app any time before your check-in day
• 12% off your first booking, plus a new offer every month
• Log back in with Face ID, fingerprint or your screen lock

Plan the trip, pick the stay, and let the mist do the rest.
en-US.promoText: 12% off your first stay in Vagamon. Pay when you arrive.
en-US.releaseNotes: Log in with Face ID or screen lock, first-stay and monthly offers, and a faster app.
